name: Daman-e-Koh
notes: Ridge trail above Pir Sohawa, 1-2 h from Islamabad. Paved and railed most of the way. The most reliable trail on this list in any weather short of a storm.

name: Margalla Hills NP
notes: National park network west of Islamabad, trails from Daman-e-Koh up through Saidpur and Monaha. Wildlife sightings most likely in early morning.

name: Murree
notes: Pine forest and viewpoints on the Mall Road side. Heavy weekend footfall; the lower paths get churned to mud quickly after rain.

name: Galiyat
notes: Autumn colour through mid-October. The ridge section is exposed and picks up wind with little warning. Forest approach is easy; the ridge is the commitment.

name: Kaghan
notes: Kaghan valley, Babusar road start. Meadow trails through the valley floor. Post-monsoon the meadows hold water and the lower routes turn to mud.

name: Babusar
notes: The Babusar Pass road, above 3,800 m. Six hours each way from Islamabad. First snow of the season can close it in October. If the pass is white, turn around.
